result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.local_clustering_coefficient()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Compute local clustering coefficient for each node. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L18949-L19089){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.local_clustering_coefficient( attr_name=None, return_dict=False, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} ![Local clustering coefficient](/assets/graphs/local-clustering-coefficient.light.svg){.lightbox fig-alt="The shared seven-node graph shaded by local clustering, the fraction of each node's neighbor pairs that are linked. A's two neighbors are linked, so A scores 1.00, down to F at 0; the pendant G has a single neighbor, so its value is undefined, drawn faded and listed as None." width="100%"} The local clustering coefficient measures how close a node's neighbors are to being a complete subgraph (clique). For a node with k neighbors, it's the fraction of possible edges between neighbors that actually exist. For undirected graphs: `C(v) = 2 * triangles(v) / (k * (k-1))` For directed graphs: `C(v) = triangles(v) / (k_out * (k_out-1))` Nodes with fewer than 2 neighbors return `None` (clustering undefined). Time complexity: `O(m * d_max)` where `m` is edges and `d_max` is maximum degree. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [attr_name]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Name of the node attribute to store clustering coefficient values. If `None`, uses `local_clustering_coefficient` as the attribute name. [return_dict]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If `True`, returns a dictionary mapping node IDs to clustering coefficients. If `False`, stores values as node attributes and returns the Graph for chaining. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Union[dict[int, Optional[float]], Graph]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If `return_dict=` is `True` we receive a dictionary mapping node IDs to clustering coefficients (`0.0` to `1.0`), or `None` for nodes with degree < `2`. If `return_dict=` is `False`, this returns self for method chaining. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Measure clustering in a network: ::: {#74b79928 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_nodes(["A", "B", "C", "D", "E"]) .add_edges([("A", "B"), ("B", "C"), ("C", "A"), # Triangle: A,B,C ("A", "D"), ("A", "E")]) # A has additional neighbors ) clustering = graph.local_clustering_coefficient(return_dict=True) node_a_id = graph.get_id_from_label(label="A") node_b_id = graph.get_id_from_label(label="B") node_d_id = graph.get_id_from_label(label="D") # Node A: Lower clustering (not all neighbors connected) # Node B: 1.0 (all neighbors connected) # Node D: None (degree 1, clustering undefined) clustering[node_a_id], clustering[node_b_id], clustering[node_d_id] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` (0.16666666666666666, 1.0, None) ``` ::: ::: ::: {#f5add946 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Convert to labels if needed clustering_by_label = { graph.get_label_from_id(node_id=nid): coeff for nid, coeff in clustering.items() } # Returns clustering coefficient for node A clustering_by_label['A'] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` 0.16666666666666666 ``` ::: ::: Store as node attributes and chain: ::: {#6857518f .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_nodes(["A", "B", "C"]) .add_edges([("A", "B"), ("B", "C"), ("C", "A")]) .local_clustering_coefficient() # Stores as 'local_clustering_coefficient' attribute ) # Access stored values node = graph.get_node(graph.get_id_from_label("A")) # Returns Node A clustering coefficient node.attributes['local_clustering_coefficient'] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` 1.0 ``` ::: ::: Find highly clustered nodes (hubs): ::: {#a13add1c .cell execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_nodes(["A", "B", "C"]) .add_edges([("A", "B"), ("B", "C"), ("C", "A")]) ) clustering = graph.local_clustering_coefficient(return_dict=True) hubs = { node_id: coeff for node_id, coeff in clustering.items() if coeff and coeff > 0.5 } # Returns dictionary of highly clustered node IDs with their coefficients hubs ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=4} ``` {1: 1.0, 3: 1.0, 2: 1.0} ``` ::: :::
